'''Mr. Monday Night Bow to the Darkside!!!! (DLSC)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mr. Monday Night]]
* '''Published:''' 22 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Let Them Make The First Move
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 FirstMove Night DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

DS Lightsaber Combat
